additional_info.body:
Hello Furkan,
Hope you are doing great.
As per your reported issue, we have analyzed and found that the contactor has been in an abnormal operation state multiple time.
Mon, 27 Jan 2025 09:26:29 GMT
2025-01-27, 09:26:29
2025-01-27T09:26:29.200530+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/6a6d0d1dbd48[732]: PLC-Error-Flag 'DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10' changed from true - ('coontactor stuck at ON feedback') to true - ('coontactor stuck at ON feedback, waiting for reset')
Mon, 27 Jan 2025 08:39:22 GMT
2025-01-27, 08:39:22
2025-01-27T08:39:22.190866+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [SCO] SMC[0]: MG1-MG2_QA09-10, COMMAND: off, FEEDBACK: on, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK Timeout), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT:
Please check the QA09-10 contactor and proceed with the replacement if necessary.
Let us know if you have further queries.
Additionally, a new feature has been implemented in the charger firmware for the self-check test of contactor operations.
For detailed information on how the test is performed, please follow the link in the wiki:
Matrix Contactors/Coils Self Test - EV Charger Development - Confluence (siemens.cloud)
As per the fault code of the error:
Contactors in group 0 failed the test, and groups 1, 2, and 3 tests were skipped.
Adding to the information provided earlier:
Status:
failed,
Reason:
smc[0,1,2,3]-[states]-[results]
Status:
failed,
Reason:
smc[0,1,2,3]-[P,P,P,S]-[0,0,0,0] : in charger
So, the details are as follows:
SMC0: QA9/QA10
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
In the error code status [F,S,S,S], it denotes that the SMC0 contactor check failed, and SMC1, 2, and 3 were skipped. The [0,0,0,0] denotes that the feedback for contactor QA9/QA10 was not received.
I hope this clarifies your query.
